prompt:

Person: Ana, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Ana thinks the council already has too many rules.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I heard a rumor that the council might start fining people for leaving bins out after 8am next month, though I'm not sure if that's actually confirmed. It's probably worth double-checking just in case."
text: The council is officially planning to slap us with massive fines if our bins aren't off the street by 8am sharp next month. They’re absolutely determined to control every single thing we do!
